title: Vector Export, Slices & Production Output
subtitle: Export Persona, Multi-Density Slices, Continuous Export, SVG Optimization & Press PDF/X
description: Master commercial production output in Affinity Designer: harness the dedicated Export Persona, create dynamic layer-based slices, automate multi-density (1x/2x/3x) asset pipelines with Continuous Export, optimize clean semantic SVG code for web and app development, and generate press-ready PDF/X files with bleed and printer marks.
prerequisites: D01: Designer Interface, Personas & Canvas Setup
D08: Symbols, Linked Assets & Component Systems
D09: Pixel Persona Integration & Textured Vector Shading
learningOutcomes: Navigate the Export Persona workspace and distinguish document, artboard, and layer-based slices.
Configure automated multi-density asset pipelines across 1x, 2x, and 3x scale factors for PNG, WebP, and SVG.
Operate the Continuous Export engine to trigger automated background asset rebuilding upon saving.
Audit and optimize SVG export presets with clean viewBox coordinates, decimal precision, and flattened transforms.
Generate press-ready PDF/X-1a and PDF/X-4 commercial print documents with 300 DPI rasterization and bleed marks.

capstoneProject.title: Multi-Platform Production Delivery Package
capstoneProject.description: Prepare a comprehensive commercial delivery package from an enterprise brand system: automate continuous multi-density slicing (1x/2x/3x PNG and WebP), export optimized lightweight SVGs with responsive viewBoxes, and generate a preflight-verified PDF/X-4 print sheet with trim marks and 3mm bleed.
evaluationCriteria: Layer-based slices established in Export Persona for all core icons and UI cards.
Multi-density presets configured with correct scale suffixes (@1x, @2x, @3x).
Exported SVG files verified clean in code editor without bloated base64 raster blobs.
Press PDF/X-4 rendered with active trim marks, registration marks, and 3mm bleed margin.
